$comment: The request-status page's event definition, copied from docs/status-events.schema.json at the Eranos web commit 59c932c (F-UI-STALE-001), so the worker's facts are tested against the page's own shape.

type.description: received; plan_claimed (the request verb claimed to plan it); planned (split into parts); queued (a place in line); work_claimed / check_claimed (a part's work or its review claimed); work_submitted; check_approved / check_sent_back (the review verdict); signoff_required / signed_off; delivered (report) / published (kit); library_added; decided (a person's decision, from the decision task); heartbeat; closed; reopened (a closed request open again, for example after a wrong library reuse; the earlier facts stay in the history); withdrawn. A delivered or published fact with summary.reused true before any plan means the request was answered from the library with no new work. check_refused: Tessera refused a check because the maker tried to approve its own work (the board's 'refused'; cite the refusal's record).

at.description: Unix seconds of the receipt or event.

receipt.description: Claim receipts: sha256(canonical_json({namespace, task_id, fencing_token, claimed_at})). Submit and review: Tessera's receipt_hash.

ref.description: A record reference when Tessera writes no hash, e.g. 'eranos.catalog/KIT-R1234567-02 version 3'.

model.description: The model the worker declares it runs.

lease_ends.description: Unix seconds when the lease expires.

place.description: The request's place in line before planning (queued, received).

places.description: Place in line by part number (queued, planned).

note.description: decided with choice 'changes': the requester's note; that part goes back in line.

result_id.description: delivered: RPT-... (eranos.solutions key); published: KIT-... (catalog id); library_added: either.

library_ref.description: library_added: the public URL of the library entry.

dedicated.description: work_claimed or check_claimed by one of Eranos's own workers: volunteers get the first pick, and a task nobody claims within about 90 seconds of entering the line goes to a dedicated worker run by the ta-amps team on Meta's latest Muse model through the Meta API (standard tier), under the same claim and report rules. Without this field the page treats a worker label starting with 'eranos' as dedicated.

decision_task_brief.description: Option A: a person's decision is filed by the requester key as one request verb on eq01 (kind 'request'); the worker that claims it records a 'decided' event, with its submit receipt, on the original request's history.

request_brief.description: The brief of the request verb on eq01 (kind 'request'), as the request box files it with the requester key. The same fields are written to the requester's org.requests noun.

follows.description: An improvement of an earlier request ('Improve an earlier request'), or a part sent back with a note.

prefs.description: Advanced settings, only what was chosen (RequestForm board).

other.description: Text typed into a question's Other box, by question id (skill, runs, agents, models, tools, limits).

caption_names.description: The film's caption names (RequestStatusPage onEvent, Claude Design 20:15) for these event types. The page dispatches window CustomEvent 'eranos:status-event' with detail {n, type, band, text} for each new fact.
